blocking.title: The chunked-body claims about pi only hold for an answer that sends Connection: close. On a kept-alive connection pi retries, so the texts state a difference that is not there and miss one that is
blocking.detail: Some texts say, without a condition, that pi reads a chunked body cut short as a partial body and does not retry it. Those texts are: the CHANGELOG ('except a chunked 2xx cut short, which pi reads as a partial body and fails on without a retry'), ADR-0251 12.3 ('a chunked body cut short gives pi a partial body and a JSON SyntaxError (not retried)'), the new 12.3 bullet ('A chunked refusal cut short is refused in both (pi reads the partial body; ch401)'), 12.8, 12.9 item 2, the StatusBeforeBody docstring's Known differences, the _TRANSIENT_TRANSPORT comment, and the commit message (summary, round 5 item 1, round 6 item 2). This only holds when the answer carries Connection: close, which is the only framing the lane's recorder sent. Undici ends a socket with !shouldKeepAlive as a complete message, and chunked has no length to check. On HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, the default, pi's fetch gives 'terminated' (SocketError: other side closed) and retries. Two consequences: (a) for a chunked 2xx cut short on keep-alive, aelix MATCHES pi (both retry), yet the texts claim a difference; (b) for a chunked 401 cut short on keep-alive, pi's Anthropic and Copilot refreshes retry it while aelix refuses at all three sites. That is an unstated divergence, and the ADR says 'refused in both'. This is a text-only fix: qualify each sentence with 'when the answer says Connection: close; on a kept-alive connection pi reports terminated and retries (a 2xx at all three, a refusal at Anthropic and Copilot)'. Also add the chunked keep-alive cut to the CHANGELOG list of how pi's Anthropic and Copilot refreshes lose the status. This round's goal is that every pi sentence be exact as measured, and round 6 item 1 was the same class of over-generalisation.
